about.description: For over thirty years Louisiana Lagniappe has been known for Gulf seafood with a Creole flair. The attire is casual, yet an upscale waterfront dining experience is provided for the entire family.

menu.name: Lobster Rangoons
menu.description: Wontons stuffed with Maine Lobster and cream cheese, fried to perfection and served with our sweet chili sauce

menu.name: Louisiana Crab Cakes
menu.description: Jumbo lump crabmeat served with our tangy remoulade sauce

menu.name: Barbecue Jumbo Shrimp
menu.description: Peeled, spicy New Orleans style barbecue shrimp

menu.name: Mardi Gras Shrimp
menu.description: Fried shrimp tossed in our spicy remoulade sauce

menu.name: Oysters Lagniappe
menu.description: Baked with our Lagniappe stuffing and jumbo lump crabmeat

menu.name: Stuffed Mushrooms
menu.description: Mushroom caps filled with jumbo lump crabmeat and shrimp

menu.name: Blackened Scallops
menu.description: Blackened bay scallops served with our pineapple-rum butter sauce

menu.name: Eggplant Orleans
menu.description: Medallions of eggplant, deep fried and topped with jumbo lump crabmeat and hollandaise sauce

menu.name: Blue Crab Claws Market Price
menu.description: A Gulf Coast favorite. Available fried or sautéed

menu.name: Cajun Seafood Gumbo
menu.description: Made with jumbo lump crabmeat, shrimp and oysters

menu.name: Corn & Crab Bisque
menu.description: A rich, cream soup with jumbo lump crabmeat and fresh yellow corn. This is a Lagniappe favorite!

menu.name: Jumbo Lump Crabmeat Salad
menu.description: Iceberg, Romaine and baby spinach, tossed with a creamy house dressing and topped with fresh jumbo lump crabmeat

menu.name: Grilled Shrimp Salad
menu.description: Grilled shrimp on a bed of iceberg, Romaine and baby spinach, finished with our Dijon vinaigrette dressing

menu.name: Grouper Pontchartrain
menu.description: Fresh Gulf Grouper, pan sautéed and topped with fried jumbo soft-shell crab, hollandaise sauce and honey roasted nuts. Served with our homemade hushpuppies, house salad and twice-baked potato

menu.name: Tournedos of Beef
menu.description: Medallions of Certified Angus Beef Filet Mignon topped with sautéed jumbo lump crab meat and shrimp. Served with our homemade hushpuppies, house salad and twice-baked potato
